_comment: The 3x3 plan. Copy to plan.json (or run `dailybrief.py 3x3 init`) and edit. The brief reads this every morning; nothing here is ever fetched or invented.
_start: First day of the first month-block, YYYY-MM-DD. Each topic below gets one calendar month from this date, in order.
_review_day: The day the weekly review falls on: monday ... sunday. The brief nags on this day, and keeps nagging while a stale set is still showing.
_topics: Three topics, one per month -- e.g. "Psychoacoustics", "Ottoman history", "Bread fermentation"; make at least one unrelated to your work, which is where being interesting about the unexpected comes from. Each has three sources: video (a lecture or talk), text (an article, book or long-form journalism), misc (a course, a series, anything). Week 1 is the video, week 2 the text, week 3 the misc, week 4 is producing the output. Names and sources are left blank on purpose: an empty slot is reported as empty, and the brief will never show a topic you did not choose.
_weekly: Three changes you run for one week, picked on review day. `week_of` is the review day they were filed under -- when it falls behind the current week the brief flags them as stale rather than letting a month-old set masquerade as this week's. Set them with `3x3 week "a" "b" "c"`, score them with `3x3 score kept dropped retry`.
